summary: Source re-review repaired the Table 1 activity matrix, corrected the scaffolded Table 2/3 entity assignments, matched supported DBAASP assay rows to primary-source locators, preserved unresolved DRAMP/CAMP and SK-OV-3/OVCAR-3 conflicts, and replaced the placeholder mechanism note with source-bounded ClpC1 proteolysis/binding claims.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 owner-layer rework is complete for locally obtainable evidence. The paper is publication-grade with explicit database/sequence-normalization cautions, not clean acceptance.

source_review_depth.notes: Reviewed packet raw XML/PDF, extracted PDF text, supplementary PDF text/index, locator index, and linked database JSONL snapshots; no external recovery was used.

nonblocking_gaps: Supplementary PDF contains phylogeny/strain context and no parsed activity table; it does not change activity/toxicity/database adjudication.
Exact figure datapoints from images were not inferred; mechanism/activity claims are limited to source text, captions, XML tables, and text-supported values.
linked_sequence_records is empty, so no database sequence normalization is claimed.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker-2_activity_toxicity: Accepted with cautions: XML Tables 1-3 and text-supported RUFI MBC/nonreplicating MIC claims were parsed into target/entity/value/unit rows with locators; database-only values were not introduced as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker-4_database_records: Accepted with cautions: DBAASP assay rows with primary table/text matches are source-verified for assay/citation scope; SK-OV-3 versus OVCAR-3, DRAMP placeholder sequence/name, and CAMP identity gaps remain explicit conflict/database-only records.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker-6_final_adjudication: Accepted with cautions: all hard owner-layer tickets were closed, remaining caveats are nonblocking and represented in final artifacts.
per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism: Accepted with cautions: direct ClpC1 proteolysis/binding/genetic-support claims are source-locator backed and do not infer unavailable figure datapoints.

caution_findings.reason: linked_sequence_records is empty; database rows are not used to normalize a modified cyclic peptide sequence beyond primary-source RUFI identity context.
A database IC50 row names SK-OV-3 while primary Table 3 reports OVCAR-3 for the 14 μM RUFI row.
DRAMP/CAMP identity details are retained as source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source where local material does not verify exact sequence/source database identity.
Figure-only exact datapoints are not fabricated; final claims use source text, captions, XML tables, and text-supported values.
